Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and a positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, strongly indicating a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
